name: Markdown Index
description: Admin report that indexes and displays the .md files found in the site's root/contrib/custom/vendor folders.
project_description:
Generates an index of markdown files and the ability to view them. 

 Features 
 Provides a site administrator a report of all the markdown files in certain pre-defined folders, and the ability to view any one of them. Useful report for admin reference.

 Post-Installation 
 Navigate to the settings form to include the folders that you want included in the report.

 
 Configuration -> System -> Markdown Index Settings 
 /admin/config/system/markdown-index 
 
 After enabling the module see "Markdown Index" in the "Reports" menu.

 
 Reports -> Markdown Index Report 
 /admin/reports/markdown-index 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 None.

 Recommended modules/libraries 
 Markdown for better formatting (todo).
